audience.programmeDescription: Study the Bible, Christian doctrine, church history and practical theology within the Reformed tradition, with biblical-language study and reflection on faith, church and society.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers meaningful connections through philosophy, literary interpretation, religious culture and psychology. These do not provide a sufficiently close response to the sustained biblical, doctrinal and practical theological study in this program. The documented allocation is shown; unresolved progression rules do not change this academic finding.
